topic: Why Exhausted Brains Snap Wide Awake in Bed — Conditioned Arousal, the 60% Glymphatic Wash, and the Sleeping-Pill Paradox

three_layer_formula.everyday_problem: Exhausted all evening on the couch, snapping wide awake the second your head hits the pillow, waking before dawn, and reaching for sedative sleeping pills to force eight hours of unconsciousness.
psychology_studies: Perlis & Bootzin (1997, J. Sleep Research, 10.1111/j.1365-2869.1997.00179.x): Pavlovian conditioned bedroom arousal elevates high-frequency beta cortical activity at sleep onset and makes staying in bed strengthen wakefulness; Bootzin's stimulus-control chair rule breaks the cue.

Yoo & Walker (2007, Current Biology, 10.1016/j.cub.2007.08.007): 35 hours without sleep severs medial prefrontal top-down braking and amplifies human amygdala reactivity to negative emotional images by +60%.
neuroscience_studies: Xie & Nedergaard (2013, Science, 10.1126/science.1241224): Two-photon imaging shows glial interstitial channels expand by 60% during natural sleep, clearing beta-amyloid twice as fast as wakefulness.

Fultz & Lewis (2019, Science, 10.1126/science.aax5440): Simultaneous EEG + fast fMRI in 13 sleeping humans reveals coupled slow-wave neural silence, cerebral blood volume drop, and large fourth-ventricle cerebrospinal fluid waves every ~20 seconds.

Hauglund & Nedergaard (2025, Cell, 10.1016/j.cell.2024.11.027): Slow ~50-second locus coeruleus norepinephrine waves drive rhythmic arterial vasomotion that pumps glymphatic fluid during natural NREM sleep, whereas sedative zolpidem suppresses norepinephrine oscillations by ~50% and cuts brain fluid transport by ~30%.

debate_ignition.midpoint_open_loop: If unconsciousness alone opened those fluid channels, then knocking yourself out with a sleeping pill should wash the brain just as clean — so why did 2025 brain-pump recordings reveal the exact opposite?
debate_ignition.open_verdict_ending: If tonight only gives you one option, would you take five hours of natural slow-wave sleep or eight sedated hours on a sleeping pill?
debate_ignition.offcenter_creator_bet: My bet: I'd take 5 real hours over pills — sedatives mute the vascular pump that flushes night waste. Would you choose 5 hours of natural deep sleep or 8 sedated hours?
